identity.title: [v0.91.8][tools][ci] Add proportional fast lane for small fixes

values.goal: Reduce development latency by making validation, review, PR watching, and lifecycle effort proportional to issue risk.
values.required_outcome: A checked-in fast-lane policy and focused contract proof define how tiny tool/docs/test fixes move quickly without weakening typed C-SDLC v2 authority or exact-head truth.
declared_scope: validation routing documentation link and policy reference to the validation selector
small focused shell contract test for policy invariants
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 remains the lifecycle authority
fast lane changes validation selection and operator behavior, not product/runtime semantics
GitHub wait states must be changed-state/blocker reporting only
operator_constraints: Use FastWork for worktree, temp, and Rust build output
Do not write on root main
No raw GitHub CLI or connector fallback for issue lifecycle
